theorems.name: Submission.p10_17ae7b7d_fi_square_annihilation
theorems.statement: ∀ (p a j : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → j < a → ∀ z : ZMod (p ^ a), p ^ j ∣ z.val → ¬ p ^ (j + 1) ∣ z.val → ∀ n : ℕ, ((n : ZMod (p ^ a)) * z ^ 2 = 0 ↔ p ^ (a - 2 * j) ∣ n)
